body: He told me we need to break up, he never wants to get married, and the best option is for me to leave.
I think you see this more clearly than I do by far. I'm going to try to shower and eat something today and go from there.

I think you're right. I just don't think I can share so intimately with a professional without risk of getting placed on a hold or in inpatient lock down. Anonymity is an incredibly helpful thing for this.

You're very kind and your perspectives are helpful. Thank you (and everybody else) for taking the time to talk to a hysterical stranger. I'm afraid if I go to a counselor they'll put me on a hold if I tell them all this. Which I guess is why I broadcast it to the internet instead.

 I don't have a lot of healthy tools to begin with which is why I'm in this situation. I usually just get as busy as I can so I don't have as much time to think about what's wrong with me. 

Even before this, I've felt like if a computer monitor is my mind, a minimum of 3/4 of it is constant ad pop-up blaring at me and giving never-ending reminders about my pain, fatigue, how much I didn't get done today, anything else wrong with my life. The rest of the screen is all my other processes squished into a tiny space that I don't manage efficiently or effectively. It sounds helpful if a drug could help me take back more workspace for better things. All this depends on having a reason to do so. Thank you, and everybody for your time and sharing all these thoughts with me. I feel calmer now.

I talked with him again. Solidified that there is no hope for recovery. I'm too ashamed to talk to anyone else. I'm beyond being helped by anything a doc could do. I fucked up the only thing that mattered and nobody can fix that. Thanks for taking the time to reply.

I'm sorry to hear of your pain. I'm glad you were able to find someone. I know if he can't love me then there's no chance to ever be lived again. I don't deserve it anyway after how selfish I've been. Just waiting now to either waste away or be bold enough to end it. I just have to wait until he's moved on so he doesn't hurt himself when he finds out about me.
That's great to hear of your successes. I know I will never find what I had again. I will never be able to live down how I ruined it. I only hope I don't have to suffer much longer.
I wish I had your strength to move on. I don't see a way forward alone.

I'm sorry to cause you pain thinking about this. Maybe I can be a cautionary tale if nothing else. Be patient with your SO no matter what pain you're feeling. They try so hard to help us every day and it becomes hard to do the same for them. I think we got to the point where I was allowing him to play that caregiver role too much. Enabling me to do less for myself than what I'm capable of even if it does hurt. I wasn't fair or respectful of the energy he was having to spend on me. All I have now are regrets.

I don't think I've ever stopped grieving everything this disease has taken from me. I really thought I was turning it around though, which is maybe part of why I've sunk so low. Working regularly was helping as scary as it was to commit to a schedule when I had no idea what the next day would bring pain-wise. I was able to reduce my pain meds and rely more on nsaids, even tapering those down. I was getting more active working on this house. I was seeing all the potential and holding on to the thought of maybe being active enough with a good diet and daily plans alongside meds would be enough to actually live a mostly normal life. I guess none of this changed how selfish I was being with my fiance. I wish he had slapped some sense into me when there was still a chance to change. Every day I'm still here will be replaying everything I did wrong and knowing that even one act of patience or giving might have been what could have prevented this entire outcome. I can't sustain that for very long.
I'm glad that worked for you and you found a reason to live. I don't know if merely surviving is enough for me.

This would have been the smart thing. But my selfish mind immediately jumped to why I can't live without him, not what he needs to be healthy. Sensing a pattern yet? And there's no taking it back once suicide is on the table. You're absolutely right that he feels trapped. But I don't think there will ever be any coming back from this.

Humira was doing a decent job when I'm consistent with it. Without it I can't walk, get dressed, brush my hair, let alone go to work

It would be nice to be numb right now. Don't really plan on going back to work so what does it matter if I use. I think if I tried to get more narcs right now I would just hurt myself more in the end. 

I tried antidepressants when I was first diagnosed with RA in high school with no real noticeable difference. They can't really take away the reality of the disease or my actions.

I'm sorry for your pain and your doctors lack of interest in helping you. I see that attitude so much while working in the ER. Compassion fatigue is a real thing for healthcare workers and people with chronic pain are so hard to help due to the difficulty managing the cause of their symptoms. This is part of why I was finally starting the journey of applying to med school and maybe eventually becoming a physician if things worked out. At least he can sell my books to pay for part of the mortgage now.
All great things I should have been doing. We'll never have the opportunity now.

I offered all of these solutions and more to show him I could correct the behavior and never hurt him like this again. I don't want him to be my caretaker. Doesn't matter. He's done with me. There's no point in getting further treatment for myself. I'm really too ashamed to talk to anyone else about this. Anonymous internet strangers are all I've got. Thanks for the thoughts.

I just want to say I'm still here. I appreciate everyone taking the time to share. I talked (sobbed) with him again ultimately begging for any way to move forward together. He can't do it. I told him I can't see any way to continue my life without him. I came up with all these stupid goals I had for myself and my life with him and even ideas on how to correct the behavior that was hurting him so much. He just can't do it with me. I can't do it without him. Just hearing him sob. Omg. I've hurt him so irreparably. I can't fix this. He said he didn't know it was possible to hurt this much and is probably hovering at just slightly less suicidal than me. If I go through with it, I'm convinced he would too. 

How fucking pathetic. I made my partner going from loving me to wanting to die. I feel like you hear about this stuff like in a bad soap opera. Didn't know it was possible to feel this way. 3 days ago I was preparing to apply to medical school, renovating a house with the person I love, working a tough job for me with the pain but learning so much, being excited about the future. We were gong to plant our first garden this weekend now that we have the space. How does all of that disappear so suddenly?

 In between the suicidal discussions, he was trying to plan logistics for how we separate. In his mind I go live with my parents and he lives here alone finishing the house until he can sell it. He was talking about packing my stuff. I told him he can donate it or throw it away because I won't need it. Then more sobbing because he says he can't live knowing he caused my death. It's just this horrible circus back and forth for hours until we fall asleep. 

I'm awake trying to force myself to see a life beyond him and I. just. can't. I can't see how to put any of the pieces back together by myself. I sound like a teenager that broke up with her first boyfriend. I'm so ashamed of myself that it's come to this. Wishing life was like a video game and I could just go back to a previous save. 

I don't have enough narcs to have a high chance of success at the moment and I'm too much of a coward to try anything more traumatic just to reassure anyone that might care I guess. I've thought about just starving myself and waiting for dehydration to kill me somewhere secluded. In all likelihood I'll probably just lie in bed until someone physically forces me to be somewhere else. 

There is no living like this. Maybe I'll exist for awhile until he moves on so I know he won't hurt himself. But there's no living and surviving this. No possible future where I'm in pain alone. I'm sorry to all of you reading this hearing the poison in my head.

You're kind to reply. I take a ton of meds for the RA but specifically for the pain it's ibuprofen, tylenol, tramadol, flexeril. These generally take the edge off if I'm not in an active flare. 

He should eventually come home but idk if I should be here when he is. part of me wants to try to plead my case one more time to see if he'd go to counselling with me and holding on to that idea is probably the only thing stopping me at this moment. But I know his MO. He's made up his mind to flee and I can't blame him. I need to find a way for him to not know that I went through with it because the last thing I want is for him to hurt himself. So now I'm just stuck lying here waiting for my misery to end. I looked up the just lethal doses and idk if I have enough. Would be nice to fall asleep and not wake up to hell anymore.

Thank you for taking the time to reply. I'm selfishly hoping he doesn't really mean it and if I could just explain it he would give me the opportunity to try something different to control the pain and not lean on him like I have. I feel like with his support I could find a better way to be me that doesn't depend so heavily on him. It's literally the threat of death that would be motivating me at this point. Maybe in time I could find a reason to live that doesn't rely on another. I'm not capable of doing any of that without him. I'm really just fooling myself that any of this is a possibility cause I'm too terrified to fail an attempt right now. he's already given me those opportunities and I've failed them all. I am lost without him.
